meta.name: cqrs-implementation
meta.description: Implement Command Query Responsibility Segregation for scalable architectures. Use when separating read and write models, optimizing query performance, or building event-sourced systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实现CQRS架构，分离读写模型以提升系统扩展性
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在设计或重构后端架构,需要分离读写模型来应对高并发查询。
copy.tagline_en: Implement CQRS to separate read and write models for scalable architectures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing or refactoring backend architecture to handle high-concurrency reads and writes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 CQRS(命令查询职责分离)思路协助设计:写操作用命令,读操作用查询,两者分开建模;并给出事件同步、组件职责与对应模板。
howto.when: 当你要求分离读模型和写模型、优化查询性能,或构建事件溯源(event-sourced)系统时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 CQRS 拆分订单系统的读写模型。
say.note: Claude 会给出命令侧与查询侧的架构和组件职责。

say.text: 给一个 CQRS 模板,含命令、事件和投影器。
读操作很慢,请用 CQRS 优化查询性能。
say.note: Claude 会按最佳实践建议去规范化读模型等。

howto.what_en: After setup Claude follows CQRS to help design: commands handle writes, queries handle reads, and the two models are separated; it also provides event-sync flow, component responsibilities, and templates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are separating read and write models, optimizing query performance, or building event-sourced systems.

say_en.text: Help me use CQRS to split the order system's read and write models.
say_en.note: Claude will outline command-side and query-side architectures.

say_en.text: Give me a CQRS template with commands, events, and projectors.
say_en.note: It reads references/details.md to produce a concrete template.

say_en.text: Reads are slow; use CQRS to optimize query performance.
say_en.note: Claude suggests denormalizing the read model, among other practices.
